titre: The relay loop must re-read the list of work folders
regle: A long-running backup process recomputes the list of work folders at each pass; otherwise a folder created after its launch is never sent.
source: Session of 2026-10-16: 16_version_finale, created after the loop was launched, was not sent (DOSSIERS list computed at import); loop restarted.
preuve: relais_github/20261016: pass 15:53, 1382 files sent after restart
controle: After a work folder is created, the next backup run sends it.
